name: veterinary_clinic_system_015_run_maintenance_rebalance
instruction: The kennel needs a deep-clean rotation. At each location, take the lowest-numbered AVAILABLE kennel run (run_type 'kennel') and set its status to 'maintenance'. Additionally, at the location that currently has the MOST occupied runs, also set the highest-numbered available 'large_dog' run to 'maintenance' if one exists there. Do not touch occupied or cleaning runs, and make no other changes.

success_criteria.summary: From snapshot compute per location: min run_number among available kennel runs (string sort of run_number is fine — K01..K08 zero-padded) -> must be 'maintenance'. Location with most occupied runs (snapshot) -> its max-numbered available large_dog run (if any) must be 'maintenance'. All other runs unchanged. Assert exactly (3 or 4) runs changed status to maintenance.
